claims.statement: EU battery rules require up-to-date state-of-health parameters in relevant battery-management systems and provide access for residual-value evaluation.
The Commission states that battery passports can include performance, durability, reuse, and recycling information.

contrary_evidence: Legal data access does not guarantee practical access across proprietary vehicle interfaces.
OEM-certified used-car programs already reduce uncertainty for some buyers.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: recruit fleet lessors, used-EV dealers, and second-life integrators through diagnostic partners.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 12,000 annual certificates plus transaction fees could support a 5 million PLN founder net-worth path in seven to ten years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: partner technicians perform tests while the founder manages models below 20 hours weekly.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: standardized tests could reach 55% gross margin, and every commercial number including capital_required_pln is hypothetical.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: diagnostic equipment pays back after 140 completed certificates.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: charge 700 PLN per certificate and a 2% successful-auction fee.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: dealer inventory turnover and fleet disposals generate repeated tests.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A model-specific degradation and realized-resale dataset improves valuation accuracy
fingerprint.customer: Used-EV dealers, fleet lessors, and battery repurposers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Diagnostic-shop partners and fleet remarketing agreements
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Independent health test, transferable certificate, and curated B2B exchange
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The seller pays at certification and the matched buyer pays through the completed auction
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A high-value used vehicle or pack changes hands with uncertain remaining life

founder_fit: Battery analytics aligns with data science and renewable-energy interests.
Technician partnerships keep physical work and social load bounded.
risks: A wrong certificate could create safety and valuation liability.
Pack handling requires trained partners and strict procedures.

structure.commercial_archetype: Independent inspection certificate plus B2B marketplace
structure.control_point: Battery health certificate attached to the resale or repurposing transaction
structure.critical_dependency: Safe non-discriminatory BMS data access and insurer-accepted test methodology

thesis: Create a trusted state-of-health certificate and dealer auction layer for used EV packs and vehicles.
title: Used-EV Battery Health Certificate Exchange
uncertainties: Dealer willingness to accept an unfamiliar independent certificate is untested.
All commercial numbers including capital_required_pln are unvalidated hypotheses.
